parent: CGT-F0 (PASS_STRONG_GPU_TRANSLATION, pooled S_mixed~2.99x) + CGT-G5 (DROP_NATIVE_OPTIMIZATION, native training CLOSED)
question: Can the proven fast CGT renderer be inserted into canonical 3DGS training while preserving canonical optimization semantics and still produce a meaningful end-to-end time-to-quality acceleration?
does_NOT_reopen: native CGT optimization (G5 closed). Canonical 3DGS params (xyz/scale/rotation/opacity/SH/optimizer-state) remain the trainable variables. CGT is a rendering/compression layer only.

rules.clean_gpu_required: TI0 sec.19: clean/exclusive MX A100, no foreign CUDA, warmup, repeats, CUDA sync, median+spread

TI0A.what: Measure real cost of updating CGT representation after canonical optimizer step. Real topology-stable room ckpt (B1_room_multiphase_v2/iter_15000, 901818 gaussians). Real canonical optimizer deltas (gsplat forward + L1/SSIM loss + backward + Adam). theta_t -> theta_(t+1).

strategies.C: incremental coefficient update via certificate reuse (certify_tile passes -> reuse coeffs)

hard_tiers.MARGINAL_UPDATE_HEADROOM: 1.0<=S<1.15 (proceed only if one obvious low-risk removable overhead)

candidate_strategies: A: CGT forward + canonical renderer backward
B: CGT forward + recompute canonical forward for backward (account BOTH forwards)
C: CGT forward + another existing valid backward path
TI0B.gradient_semantics: MANDATORY correctness gate: if loss from CGT pixels but gradient via canonical path, verify gradient corresponds to intended objective. No silent mismatched gradients. Approximate/straight-through gradients = NEW hypothesis, separately validated.

TI0C.scope: room only, controlled topology-stable segment, paired canonical vs CGT-integrated, same ckpt/optimizer/cameras/loss/steps/eval-cams/hw.

reporting: OBSERVED/EVIDENCE/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/NOT_MEASURED/CONCLUSION; distinguish F0 forward speed vs representation update cost vs full training-step speed vs time-to-quality speed.
